name: combat.engage

implementation.description: Bounded tactical combat requests through the control arbiter.

requirements.starting_conditions: Alive, one selected hostile target, approved fixed arena setup.
requirements.equipment: Record and hold the agreed weapon and shield setup fixed across trials.
requirements.allowed_environment: Only arenas approved for frozen evaluation; none qualified yet.
requirements.observations: Ordered policy features; unknown observations retain contract defaults.

success_check.success: Selected target death, bot alive, no human intervention or safety violation.
success_check.controls: Arbiter owns writes; release controls on completion, cancellation, errors, or timeout.

reset_steps: Cancel invocation and release all controls.
Restore the approved arena terrain and remove leftover mobs, projectiles, and drops.
Restore fixed bot position, health, food, equipment, and inventory.
Restore the selected target and verify all setup before the next trial.

evaluation.note: Offline cloning metrics are not arena evaluation. Synthetic data never qualifies for activation.
